args.title: Fix merge() to let right-side overrides win
args.body:
## Problem
`merge(defaults, overrides)` was using `{**right, **left}`, which caused the left (defaults) dictionary to overwrite the right (overrides) dictionary when both defined the same key.

## Fix
Changed the merge order to `{**left, **right}` so that the right-side (overrides) values correctly take precedence over left-side (defaults) values.

## Change
- `src/merge.py`: Swap unpacking order from `{**right, **left}` to `{**left, **right}`

## Test
`tests/test_merge.py::test_right_wins` now passes.
